rationale: The original short thesis is intact and working: price remains below session VWAP ($55.01) and the 9-EMA ($54.29) on 6.7x relative volume, and the newest 1m bar was the heaviest since entry (50.8K shares) printing a marginal new low and closing near it — continued distribution, not absorption — with the risk-off tape (SPY -0.73%, VIXY +2.75%) supporting continuation to the $53.10 target and the $53.05 low retest just ~1.2% below. Worst-case stop-out at $54.68 realizes ~$142 from entry, which still fits inside the $222.85 remaining loss budget, so there is no risk-control reason to exit; flipping long against active downtrend distribution has materially weaker evidence than simply letting the defined-risk position run to target.
